# Seeker aspic

Type: Food | Internal ID: SeekerAspic | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Seeker meat x2, Magecap x2, Royal jelly x2 | Max Health: 28 | Max Stamina: 14 | Max Eitr: 85 | Duration: 30m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

# Introduction

Seeker aspic is a Mistlands-tier food.

## Recipe

Two Seeker aspic are produced at a level 5 Cauldron with:
• 2 Magecap
• 2 Royal jelly
• 2 Seeker meat

## Notes

• Seeker aspic provides the highest eitr gain in the Mistlands at 85.
• Two pieces of royal jelly yields two seeker aspics (a 2:2 ratio of royal jelly to aspic), whereas two pieces of royal jelly yield only one Yggdrasil porridge (a 2:1 ratio of royal jelly to porridge).
